units.source_text: 结巴的人为了发出第一声而焦灼万分。

en.t: A person who stutters is tormented with anxiety in order to utter the first sound.

units.source_text: 他就好像一只企图从内界浓密的粘鸟胶摆脱出来而拼死挣扎的小鸟，

en.t: He is like a small bird struggling desperately to free itself from the thick birdlime of the inner world,

units.source_text: 好不容易挣脱出来，却为时已晚矣。

en.t: and when it finally manages to break free, it is already too late.

units.source_text: 诚然，在我苦苦挣扎的时候，外界的现实似乎也有罢手等待着我的情况。

en.t: To be sure, while I was struggling bitterly, there were times when the reality of the outside world seemed to stop and wait for me.

units.source_text: 可是等待着我的现实，已经不是新鲜的现实。

en.t: But the reality waiting for me was no longer a fresh reality.

units.source_text: 纵令我费尽工夫好容易到达了外界，

en.t: Even if I spent every effort and finally reached the outside world,

units.source_text: 那里却又总是瞬间变色，完全错位了……

en.t: there it would always change color in an instant and fall completely out of place...

units.source_text: 惟有这样对我才最合适，

en.t: only this was truly suited to me,
a reality that had lost its freshness,
a reality giving off a half-rotten smell,
always lay stretched out before my eyes.
